title: VDE Bench: Evaluating The Capability of Image Editing Models to Modify Visual Documents
abstract: arXiv:2602.00122v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Image editing models can modify visual content through natural language, but editing dense documents requires precise local changes amid tightly coupled text, tables, and layout. We introduce VDE Bench, an evaluation resource for studying instruction-guided editing of Chinese and English document images. VDE Bench contains 3,506 instruction-guided image editing samples, including 1,578 text-region edits and 1,928 table-region edits. The benchmark pairs editing instructions and reference images with annotated editing regions and structured OCR outputs. Its evaluation protocol combines region-level and full-page measurements to assess textual correctness, structural fidelity, and visual content preservation. By focusing on the interaction between local edits and their surrounding document context, VDE Bench complements existing visual text editing benchmarks and provides a resource for diagnosing document-specific editing failure

translated_title: VDE Bench：评估图像编辑模型修改视觉文档的能力
translated_abstract: 图像编辑模型可以通过自然语言修改视觉内容，但对密集文档进行编辑则需要在紧密耦合的文本、表格和布局中进行精确的局部修改。我们提出了VDE Bench，一个用于研究指令引导的中英文文档图像编辑的评估资源。VDE Bench包含3,506个指令引导的图像编辑样本，其中包括1,578个文本区域编辑和1,928个表格区域编辑。该基准将编辑指令和参考图像与标注的编辑区域及结构化OCR输出配对。其评估协议结合了区域级和整页测量，以评估文本正确性、结构保真度和视觉内容保留度。通过关注局部编辑与周围文档上下文之间的交互，VDE Bench补充了现有的视觉文本编辑基准，并为诊断文档特有的编辑失败提供了资源。
tldr: 提出了VDE Bench基准，包含3,506个指令引导的中英文文档图像编辑样本，通过区域级和整页双重评估协议，系统评估图像编辑模型在密集文档中进行精确局部编辑的能力。
en_tdlr: VDE Bench is introduced as an evaluation benchmark containing 3,506 instruction-guided editing samples of Chinese and English document images, assessing image editing models' capability to perform precise local edits through combined region-level and full-page evaluation protocols.
